notes.title: Update Notes For August 19th, 2024
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix for 2 single player Wild Mages not always using the right skins
[*] The Old Guard sometimes used the incorrect portrait for their active skin
[*] Fix for clients seeing the wrong character's UI on their Action bar in some cases
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes For August 18th, 2024
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Client camera position and UI elements will represent the first character in the turn order more quickly when entering a battle
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes For August 18th, 2024
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Healing Poultice will unlock the first time you return to the main menu after your first run
[*] Fix for an error that could occur using the 'Z' hotkey to initiate a ping without being in combat
[*] Fix for an error that could occur if a player disconnected during their turn
[/list]
